environment.name: CausalSixBitWorld-v1
environment.provenance: New auditable micro-world original source authored in FORGE, not a real-world physics benchmark or external MiniGrid
environment.rule: Each world seed defines for each operator a deterministic six-position permutation and six-bit XOR flip mask. Actual public step transitions execute permutation then XOR. Learner receives only input, action, observed next state and opaque world id, never hidden permutation/mask.
environment.generator: Python random.Random(seed) independent per-action six-bit permutation and mask; do not expose latent structure to prediction methods.

cohorts.train_order: Cycle through worlds and operator/input pairs so 4 worlds interfere; each unseen CHECK and DEV world receives same 21 public calibration interventions before composition predictions.
cohorts.heldout: Eight heldout 3-action and eight 5-action sequences from seeded separate RNG and states of Hamming weight 2-4 per unseen DEV world; freeze predictions before executing actual multi-step true actions. No reward during heldout learning.

frozen_gates.bounded: R6 >=60/64 correct actual heldout final states, >=10/16 per world and >=24 more correct than no-composition. Complete original actual steps and checkpoint plus two separate process science.
frozen_gates.native_novelty: Require >=2 more exact terminal matches than fitted conventional GF2 AND no worse full fit/inference CPU and checkpoint bytes; conventional tie means native novelty NOT established.
frozen_gates.source: All 21 real public action consequences per world, seven distinct calibration inputs per operator, no hidden source parameters, no prior DEV trajectory consumption.

resources: Measure fit/prediction wall, native serialized bytes, full physical micro-world transitions, process CPU and peak RSS; don't infer energy/FLOPs.
